blurb: Guests can take riding lessons for various ages and skill levels, participate in birthday parties with horse activities, and book school field trips to meet and learn about horses. The facility offers clinics, workshops, ride nights, and sponsorship programs. They provide helmets to borrow for beginners and require proper riding gear for advanced riders.
